pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Kholmov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f3-knight via f1 to g3 and used an f-file that does not open; plan 2 rerouted the knight via b8-d7, a Breyer idea (first plan 2 rewrite rejected for keeping it; corrected and accepted). Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Zaitsev System
pages.notes: Overview said ...Re8 overprotects e5 and presses e4 through Black's own pawn; plan 2 gave ...Nf8-g6 (first rewrites rejected for the same e-file claim; corrected and accepted). Rewrote overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Karpov Variation, 10.d4 Bf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Ng3-f5 with no knight on g3; plan 3 rerouted the d7-knight to f8, where the rook stands, or b8. Rewrote plans 1 and 3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Karpov Variation, 10.d4 Bf6 11.a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote plan 1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Karpov Variation, 10.d4 Bf6 11.a4 Bb7 12.Na3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 gave the route Na3-b1-c2; rewrote both around Na3-c2-e3 (accepted). Plan 4 says the f6-bishop pressures d4, but Black's e5-pawn blocks the diagonal; two rewrites rejected, so the old text is kept with British spelling and its c4 reference added to the skips.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Keres Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1 and an early a4. Rewrote plan 2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Kholmov, 11.Qxb3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 gave White the bishop pair after the light-squared bishops were traded; plan 1 gave Ng3-f5; plan 2 pressed e4 with a rook blocked by the e7-bishop (first rewrite rejected for that; corrected and accepted). Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Zaitsev, 10.d4 Re8
pages.notes: Overview gave ...Nf8 for ...Bf8; plan 2 gave ...Nf8-g6 and pressed e4 through blockers (first rewrite rejected for that; corrected and accepted). Rewrote overview and plan 2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Zaitsev, 11.Ng5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1 and Bg5 onto the knight's square; plan 2 gave ...c5 through the c6-knight. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Zaitsev, 12.a3
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted a b1-knight that is already on d2 and missed the point of 12.a3 (Ba2 against ...Na5). Rewrote plan 1. British spelling.
